name: io.github.aminshennan/sudan-atlas
title: Sudan Atlas
description: Match Sudanese place names (Arabic or English) to official P-codes; get places and boundaries.

tools.name: match_place_name
tools.description: Match one state or locality name, in Arabic or English and any spelling, to its official P-code. Returns pcode (null when not confident), names, score 0-1, method (exact, variant, fuzzy, ambiguous, none) and up to three alternatives.

name.description: The place name as written, e.g. 'Elfasher' or 'الفاشر'

state_hint.description: The state, as a name in any spelling or a P-code such as SD02

level.description: 1 for states, 2 for localities; leave out if unknown

tools.name: match_place_names
tools.description: Match up to 1,000 names at once (for example a spreadsheet column). Each item can carry its own state hint. Results are in the same order as the input.

name.description: The place name as written, in Arabic or English

state_hint.description: The state this name is in, as a name in any spelling or a P-code such as SD02

names.description: The names to match, each with its own optional state hint (1 to 1,000)

level.description: 1 for states, 2 for localities; leave out if unknown

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find states and localities whose official English or Arabic name contains the text, best first, with the matcher's answer for misspellings.

query.description: Part of a state or locality name, in Arabic or English, e.g. 'Nyala' or 'نيالا'

limit.description: How many places to return, 1 to 25 (default 10)

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Official names, level, parent state, localities (for a state), area in km² and estimated population (COD-PS 2025, mid-2025) for a P-code.

pcode.description: A P-code such as SD02 or SD02114

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: All 19 admin-1 units (18 states and the Abyei PCA area), or the localities of the whole country or of one state.

level.description: 1 to list the states (and the Abyei PCA area), 2 to list localities

state_pcode.description: With level 2, only the localities of this state, e.g. SD02; leave out for all 189

tools.name: get_boundary
tools.description: The boundary as a GeoJSON Feature (EPSG:4326) with the place's properties. 'light' is small and enough for most maps; 'medium' is more detailed.

pcode.description: A P-code such as SD02 (a state) or SD02114 (a locality)
